description: This PHP source file defines the InstallerCountryListCommand class, which is a console command for listing or retrieving country codes within the OrangeHRM installer module. It provides functionality to display a list of countries, optionally filtering by a specified country name, and is part of the command-line interface for the installation setup.

classes.name: InstallerCountryListCommand
classes.description: A console command class that provides functionality to list countries or get specific country codes during the installation process.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command, which is 'install:country-list'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command by adding an option 'country' with a shorthand 'c'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command: fetches list of countries, optionally filters by a provided country name, and outputs the result.
